artifacts.artifact_role: Development-only row-level raw probability and immutable provenance ledger for reproducibility and later calibration.
downstream_use: development-only calibration fitting/evaluation with causal separation
artifacts.expected_storage_location: Current verified local path above; future durable external URI must be recorded prospectively without replacing this identity contract.

generation_contract.process: Execute the frozen Sprint 49 selections under the accepted Sprint 50-R1 expanding-forward protocol, serialize project fragments in frozen project order, and gzip with mtime=0.
generation_contract.regeneration_policy: Do not regenerate for packaging or calibration when the verified ledger is available; full regeneration requires separate authority.

artifacts.provenance_description: Each record binds project, algorithm, configuration, temporal CV origin, row identity, original TRAIN/VALIDATION provenance, observed development label, and raw positive-class probability.

schema.name: q1_sprint50_raw_probability_provenance_jsonl
schema.serialization: deterministic gzip JSON Lines; gzip mtime=0

scientific_dependencies: Sprint 50 condition and temporal membership identities
verification_process: Require the declared local materialization path to exist.
Verify compressed byte size and SHA-256.
Stream and validate every gzip JSONL record against the frozen schema.
Fail closed before calibration on any mismatch.
